title: DJIA Market Happenings For Wednesday, January 16, 2019
text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Wednesday, January 16, 2019 Posted by admin on January 16th, up +105 points.
Tuesday the Dow was up +155.75 (+0.65%) at 24,065.59.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +3.16%.
There were 23 Dow stocks up Tuesday.
The Dow stock winners Tuesday Tuesday
Goldman Sachs (GS) smashed fourth quarter earnings estimates with a bottom line of $6.04 per share, well ahead of the consensus forecast of $4.45. Group revenues were also surprisingly solid, at $8.08 billion, sending shares nearly 6% higher and adding 45 points to the Dow Jones Industrial Average.
European stocks are mostly lower and Asian markets ended mostly higher.
The national average price of gasoline is down one-tenth of a cent at $2.242 reported earnings on 1/15/2019 before the market open of $2.28, just beating estimates of $2.272 per share.
Goldman Sachs (GS) reported earnings on 1/16/2019 before the market open of $$6.04, beating estimates calling for $4.30 per share.
